messages.subject: Harriet's advice in - 60% to defeat the cap
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Harriet's written advice is in. Headlines: breach very strong; incorporation/last-shot point bad for Brevdale; she puts our prospects of defeating the clause 12 cap altogether at ~60%, and the Stratton remoteness head at ~70%. Expected recovery £1.05m-£1.20m weighting the risks, best case the full £1,558,150 + interest, worst case £916,800 if the cap bites. She recommends a Part 36 at ~£1.15m and not accepting below £900k. Saved to the matter file under privilege.

James
